answer: Consolidation haircuts tax a farm when it cashes out: rewards melt free at glacier pace, and each account sending vested coins to one wallet, like a vine tracing back to its root, forfeits more than the last. The nth head loses n percent, so a hundred fakes lose everything at the end. Mule wallets add bonded hops, raising the bill. Lone agents float clear like a lotus; audited merchants post bonds for exemption.
